question: Seema is twice as old as Alka. If nine years is subtracted from Alka’s age and six years is added to Seema’s age, then Seema will be four times Alka’s age. How old was Alka three years ago?
solution:
**Given:**

Seema is twice as old as Alka

9 years subtracted from Alka’s age

6 years added to Seema’s age

Then Seema becomes four times Alka

 

Calculations:

 

Let present age of Alka = x years

Present age of Seema = 2x years

New age of Alka = x − 9

New age of Seema = 2x + 6

According to question:

⇒ 2x + 6 = 4(x − 9)

⇒ 2x + 6 = 4x − 36

⇒ 4x − 2x = 6 + 36

⇒ 2x = 42

⇒ x = 21

⇒ Present age of Alka = 21 years

⇒ Age of Alka 3 years ago = 21 − 3 = 18 years

**∴ Alka was 18 years old three years ago.**
